Project board, milest
ms.report:
Cloud Native Blockchain Archive Node Milestone 1: Complete
The relational database and key value storage interfaces have been implemented as specified in their corresponding tickets. Migration of the sqlite and badger implementations to the relational and key value interfaces created above has been completed. 
This is further evidenced by the automated testing where applicable and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. As this stage has not delivered a usable product, rather creates building blocks for the next two milestones, we direct you to reference the pull requests and review the files changed to confirm, in the GitHub Milestone 1 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/17. All Milestone 1 tickets have been completed and closed. Corresponding usage documentation will be added as we progress and will be found alongside existing Dingo documentation here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dingo/blob/main/README.md.

・Unit tests were used if applicable and we've included short https://youtu.be/F1PVl31YWRQ that shows each closed output's issue and the corresponding pull request and approvals.

All of these can be visually confirmed in the GitHub project board (link below) by opening each issue/output. https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/17/views/7 
Alongside code changes, any relevant documentation updates are added to the README, https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dingo/blob/main/README.md.
This milestone delivers transparent proxying for immutable block data and data pruning support for immutable data workflows. With these capabilities, nodes can offload immutable block data handling through the archive-node pattern and reduce local storage burden through pruning when paired with the archive node.
